verdict.rationale: Adyen's docs explicitly document idempotency-key support to safely retry API requests without duplicate processing ('The Adyen API supports idempotency, allowing you to retry a request multiple times while only performing the action once', with the exact header mechanism 'idempotency-key:'). This directly matches the developer story of safe retries preventing duplicate charges. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of idempotency behavior in production and details on key expiration/edge-case handling.
